episodes.title: Corps
episodes.summary: Ballerina Neveah arrives at Chicago's famed Archer School to find cruel new rivals — and the disturbing truth behind her surprise acceptance.

episodes.title: Range of Motion
episodes.summary: Ramon's new ballet creates controversy — and opportunity. Bette goes to extremes to hide her injury, while Oren wrestles with his own secrets.

episodes.title: Class Act
episodes.summary: A fundraising gala sets the stage for drama, as Nabil stirs suspicion and Bette makes a scene. Tensions between Oren and Shane hit a breaking point.

episodes.title: Dance Dance Revolution
episodes.summary: Neveah urges the troupe to rise up against Ramon, while June battles her mother for emancipation. Bette tries a new tactic to score pills.

episodes.title: Split Sole
episodes.summary: Neveah's mom resurfaces, along with bad memories. The dancers play detective and pinpoint a suspect in Cassie's fall. Bette flips the script on Ramon.

episodes.title: Joie de Vivre
episodes.summary: A music video audition promises a big break for a lucky few. Shane and Bette flirt with new love interests, but June has a traumatic encounter.

episodes.title: Catch & Release
episodes.summary: Neveah, June and Bette's undercover sting to catch a predator goes sideways. Mixing business with pleasure puts Madame's reign at risk.

episodes.title: Relevé
episodes.summary: A photo shoot sheds new light on problems within the group. Neveah pays a price with Madame for talking to the press. Cassie's condition takes a turn.

episodes.title: It's Not the Waking, It's the Rising
episodes.summary: The dancers step up with a viral video to save the school from the expose's fallout. Armed with new evidence, Officer Cruz makes an arrest.

episodes.title: Push Comes to Shove
episodes.summary: Everything reaches a turning point on the last night of "Ripper," as the dancers pull off a jaw-dropping finale and shocking secrets are revealed.
